description: This Kotlin source file defines the AiInsightsFragment class, which provides a chat-like AI insights UI component within an Android application. It handles user input, classifies prompts into suggestion categories, interacts with an AI suggestion service to fetch suggestions, and displays messages in a list view.

classes.name: AiInsightsFragment
classes.description: A Fragment providing a UI for AI-generated suggestions based on user prompts; includes initialization of repository and service, UI setup, and prompt classification logic.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the repository and AI suggestion service.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up UI components, including message list, input field, send button, and their event handlers.

methods.name: classify
methods.description: Classifies user prompts into categories like hydration, sleep, nutrition, exercise, or motivation based on keyword matching.
